reviews.review:
this game is the top military simulation (it is the only one).
only problem for this game is : you must have high end pc for standard to high graphic for ultra graphic seting require lot more than high end pc. the game work on ultra until you dont start masive fights with tanks and helicopter and hell on screen. Then the engine show his weak points. it is not optimized for this, In game like cod and battlefield you will play at max setting at 120 fps, but here goes from 90 to 19. but this game is not only on franatic action and who will have more head shoots and kills. Here is all about teamwork, how to stay alive in war, in cordinating actions, comunicating with team, making right choices at right time. Here one good mission take 2h at least to complete if first you dont get bullet and you even didnt see enemy. this game is war and all about the war and military life. it is not for cod generations... they will be very frustrating in game like this. here you use brain, pace and time and military skill will be  useful. 

This game need update on engine and how he work on massive battle. LOD optimization and few fixes. But guys work all the time on this matter. Arma receve all the time smol and big patches. Updates on sound, weapon handling, graphic problems, and community does great work for this game, tons of new item vehicles, maps, mission campains and all work in mp. 

What definitly need a big update and fix is terrain builder and other tools for making maps and mission.  

for game i give
8/10 need more optimization only that is problem here.. 

content official and community 10/10

for editor
5/10 need a lot more work and better setup, guide and documentation... too long learning curve, hard to make decent maps without help from youtube and lots of forums reading and searching.....
